en.headline: St Stephen’s Society opens multimedia exhibition on Jackie Pullinger’s 60 years in Hong Kong
en.dek: The show at Central Market runs until 21 October and uses found objects to recreate scenes from Kowloon Walled City and other neighbourhoods.
body: St Stephen’s Society opened a multimedia exhibition on Sunday recounting the 60 years that British missionary Jackie Pullinger has spent working with Hong Kong’s marginalised communities.

The exhibition, titled 285 Homes: Unfinished Hong Kong Stories, runs at the first-floor event space of Central Market from 18 to 21 October. Organisers said the title refers to more than 285 rented units or small houses used by Pullinger and the society over six decades.

Designed around the concept of “Hong Kong found objects” — including rusted metal sheets, tangled wires and old suitcases — the seven-zone show reconstructs everyday scenes from Kowloon Walled City, the Fuk Loi Camp in Cheung Sha Wan and other simple dwellings. Special programmes including children’s activities, personal stories and performances are scheduled during the run.
The organisers said the exhibition aims to present the real living environments in which Pullinger worked among people recovering from addiction and others on the margins of the city.

zh.headline: 聖士提芬會中環街市開《285個家》展 回望潘靈卓在港60年
zh.dek: 多媒體藝術展至10月21日於中環街市一樓舉行，以旧鐵皮、電線等香港拾得物重現九龍城寨及幸福營生活場景。
body: 聖士提芬會星期日開幕多媒體藝術展，回顧英國宣教士潘靈卓在香港服事邊緣社群的60年經歷。
展覽名為《285個家．未完的香港故事》，由18至21日在中環街市一樓活動場地舉行。18日開放時間為下午1時至10時，其後三天則為上午10時至晚上10時。主辦方指，展名中的285個家，來自潘靈卓及聖士提芬會過去60年間曾使用的超過285個租借單位或小屋。
展覽以「香港拾得物」為設計概念，包括生鋅鐵皮、交錯電線及舊行李箱等，經七大展區重現九龍城寨、長沙灣幸福營及其他簡陥家屋的生活場景。期間有兒童活動、生命故事分享及現場表演等。
主辦方指，展覽旨在呈現潘靈卓與戒毒者及其他基層社群共處的真實生活環境。
